description.text:
[About the Team and Our Impact]
We solve real-world retail challenges through deep R&D and practical technology implementation.
Our recent work has earned prominent technical recognition in Taiwan and internationally:
■ Selected for NVIDIA GTC Poster presentations in 2025 and 2026: Our technical achievements were invited for presentation at NVIDIA's annual global technology conference (GTC).
■ Selected for the 2025 IT Matters Awards (AI Selected): Named an AI Application Project of the Year, recognizing the team's technical innovation and real-world commercial impact.
■ Expanding across domestic and international markets: Our in-house AI retail solutions have been deployed in Taiwan and overseas and are moving toward large-scale commercial rollout across multiple countries.
[Role Overview]
We develop smart-retail applications for unmanned stores, smart retail cabinets, and automated vending systems. Join our core R&D team to turn AI technology into tangible business value.
Key Responsibilities:
■ Develop computer vision models for retail use cases, including product recognition, object detection, image classification, out-of-stock detection, misplaced-product detection, and anonymized shopper behavior analysis.
■ Use PyTorch to develop, train, and optimize deep learning models, addressing challenges such as occlusion, glare and reflections, visually similar products, rapid onboarding of new SKUs, and limited labeled data.
■ Build and maintain image data pipelines covering data cleaning, annotation-format conversion, data augmentation, model evaluation, and error analysis of incorrect predictions; continuously improve model accuracy.
■ Deploy models to edge devices or GPU servers, using ONNX, TensorRT, and ONNX Runtime for model conversion and inference acceleration to ensure reliable real-time operation.
■ Handle RTSP video streams and image preprocessing using OpenCV and GStreamer, and integrate these pipelines with backend services, IoT devices, hardware, and in-store systems.
■ Stay current with advances in computer vision and assess the feasibility of applying new models and methods to retail use cases.

key_values.label: 語文條件
key_values.text: 英文：精通、精通、精通、精通

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
★ Required Qualifications ★
1. Proficiency in Python, with strong coding practices and experience using Git for version control.
2. Proficiency in PyTorch, with hands-on experience in deep learning model training, validation, and inference.
3. Solid computer vision fundamentals and hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas:
■ Object Detection, such as the YOLO or DETR families
■ Image Classification
■ Segmentation
■ Product Recognition
■ Fine-grained Classification
4. Familiarity with common model architectures, including CNNs, Transformers, and Vision Transformers (ViTs).
5. Proficiency in OpenCV and image preprocessing techniques.
6. Familiarity with Linux development environments and the ability to perform basic system operations, analyze logs, and troubleshoot issues.
7. Understanding of model evaluation metrics, including mAP, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and Confusion Matrix.
★ Preferred Qualifications ★
1. Experience deploying models on NVIDIA Jetson devices, Edge AI platforms, or GPU servers.
2. Familiarity with ONNX, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, FP16 / INT8 quantization, or model inference acceleration.
3. Familiarity with containerized deployment using Docker and Docker Compose.
4. Experience with RTSP, GStreamer, DeepStream, or multi-camera stream processing.
5. Experience in retail product recognition, smart shelves, smart refrigerators, self-checkout systems, or in-store video analytics.
6. Experience with Few-shot Learning, Metric Learning, Embedding Retrieval, Re-ID, or similar-product matching.
7. Understanding of applications involving emerging vision models such as CLIP, DINO, SAM, Grounding DINO, and Vision-Language Models.
8. Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask, gRPC, MQTT, or other system integration technologies.
9. Experience with C++, CUDA, Camera SDKs, or low-level performance optimization is a strong plus.
